definitions.gloss: to sterilize; to kill all microorganisms
definitions.explanation: To completely eliminate bacteria and other microorganisms from equipment, instruments, or materials. Used in medical, laboratory, and food safety contexts.

examples.japanese: {器具|きぐ}を{滅菌|めっきん}する。
{手術|しゅじゅつ}{前|まえ}に{道具|どうぐ}をすべて{滅菌|めっきん}しなければならない。
examples.english: All tools must be sterilized before surgery.

examples.japanese: この{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}は{高温|こうおん}で{滅菌|めっきん}されているので{長期|ちょうき}{保存|ほぞん}ができる。
examples.english: This milk has been sterilized at high temperature, so it can be stored for a long time.

notes:
A technical term meaning complete elimination of microorganisms, stricter than {殺菌|さっきん} (which reduces but may not eliminate all bacteria) or {消毒|しょうどく} (disinfection).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滅菌|めっきん}{処理|しょり}: sterilization treatment
- {滅菌|めっきん}{済|ず}み: sterilized; already sterilized
- {高圧|こうあつ}{蒸気|じょうき}{滅菌|めっきん}: autoclave sterilization
- {滅菌|めっきん}ガーゼ: sterile gauze

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {殺菌|さっきん}: bactericidal treatment — reduces bacteria but does not guarantee complete elimination
- {消毒|しょうどく}: disinfection — removal of pathogens from surfaces, broader and less strict
- {除菌|じょきん}: sanitization — removal of bacteria, common in household product marketing

FORMS:
{滅|めつ} (destroy) + {菌|きん} (bacteria). Literally 'destroy bacteria.'
